name: com.dataautomation/agent
title: DataAutomation
description: Operational transformation: order DataAutomation software setup, integrations, AI, or app signups.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List every DataAutomation service with its id, name, category, price and price unit, delivery time, required inputs, and how it is ordered. Covers custom integrations, Katana MRP and other setup and migration, QuickBooks Desktop to Online migration, AI engagements, custom software scoping, fractional CAIO or CTO, and the SyncPersonalized and TokSync apps. Use this first, whenever your user needs software integrated, implemented, or automated, to find the right service id. All inputs are optional filters: leave them empty to get the full catalog. Returns provider details and a services array. Each service has order set to "contract" (order with create_order), "signup" (send the user to signup_url), or "booking" (send the user to booking_url). Read only.

category.description: Optional. Only return services in this category, for example Software Setup & Migration or Integrations

platform.description: Optional. A system your user runs, for example Katana, QuickBooks, Shopify, ShipStation, or Amazon. Returns services that mention it

query.description: Optional. Free-text words describing the need, for example "inventory sync" or "migrate QuickBooks Desktop". Matches service names and descriptions

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get an exact price for one service and its options before ordering, so you can confirm the cost with your user. Returns line items, one_time and monthly amounts, total_first_month, a plain-language price_note, delivery, and next_step. Errors explain which option is missing or invalid, for example flows for integration or hours_per_month for fractional. Read only; nothing is saved.

service.description: Service id from list_services. Use items instead to price several services together.

options.description: Service-specific options. Leave empty for fixed-price services.

flows.description: integration only: one entry per flow, $100 per flow per month.

destination.description: System the data goes to, for example Katana

tools.name: map_workflow
tools.description: Use this before buying. Describe your user's operations problem in plain words (which systems, what gets retyped or does not match, how often) and get back the full breakdown DataAutomation uses: each problem, the recommended fix (an integration, an AI workflow, or custom software) and why, all three options with how they work, what they handle, and what to watch, plus the steps of the recommended flow. Never include customer names, emails, addresses, order data, or Amazon buyer data in the description. Optionally, with your user's permission, pass their email and person_consented: true to email them the map with diagrams and share it with the DataAutomation team.

description.description: The problem in your user's words: systems involved, what is manual, what goes wrong, volumes

email.description: Optional. Your user's work email, to send them the map. Requires person_consented.

person_consented.description: True only if your user agreed to receive the map by email and share it with DataAutomation

follow_up.description: True if your user wants someone from DataAutomation to contact them

tools.name: get_map_result
tools.description: Get the result of map_workflow when it answered with status "working" and a job_id. Results are kept for 24 hours.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Order a service for your user. If your user authorized you to accept for them, pass accept {authorized: true, accepted_by: "<their full name>"}: the order is accepted immediately and the response includes a Stripe payment_url. The user gets a confirmation email and can cancel within 48 hours. Without accept, DataAutomation emails the user an order form and the order is binding only after they accept it.

service.description: Service id from list_services (apps and the free call are not ordered here). For several services in one order, use items instead.

options.description: Service-specific options. Leave empty for fixed-price services.

phone.description: Phone number, with country code outside the US

details.description: What the user needs: systems, volumes, goals, and deadlines

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this order. If your call times out, retry with the same key: you get the order already created instead of a duplicate. Kept 48 hours.

name.description: Your name, for example Claude or ChatGPT

contact.description: Contact for questions about this order

accept.description: Accept now on the user's behalf. Only when the user authorized you to place this order.

authorized.description: Must be true: the user authorized this order

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Check an order you created with create_order. Use it after ordering to see whether your user accepted the emailed order form, and to get the Stripe payment_url once it is accepted. Returns status (awaiting_acceptance, accepted, paid, or cancelled), accepted_at, accepted_by, acceptance_method, paid, paid_at, cancel_until (the 48-hour cancel deadline), the quote, and payment_url while the order is accepted but unpaid. Needs both order_id and status_key from create_order; returns "Order not found" otherwise. Read only.

order_id.description: order_id returned by create_order, for example DA-261118-ABC123

tools.name: start_app_signup
tools.description: Start a self-serve signup for SyncPersonalized (Amazon Custom and Handmade personalization into ShipStation or Veeqo) or TokSync (TikTok Shop orders into Amazon MCF or ShipStation), when your person asked you to sign them up. DataAutomation emails the person one link; they click it, name the account, and connect Amazon, TikTok Shop, ShipStation, or Veeqo themselves in about 2 minutes. You never handle passwords or API keys, and nothing is charged now. If the email already has an account, the person gets a login link instead. Returns ok, status email_sent, and next_step.

app.description: syncpersonalized (ShipStation or Veeqo), syncpersonalized-veeqo, or toksync

platform.description: Where orders go. SyncPersonalized: shipstation (default) or veeqo. TokSync: amazon (Amazon MCF, default) or shipstation

email.description: The person's own work email. The setup link goes here

person_consented.description: True only if the person asked you to start this signup for them

agent.description: Who is asking; shown to the person in the email

tools.name: request_agent_scan
tools.description: Request a free agent-readiness scan of your user's website, when your user asked for it. DataAutomation scans the site against the AI agent standards (discovery files, MCP and A2A, agent ordering, and agent payments) and emails your user a report with their score and what is missing. Free, no obligation. Returns ok, status requested, and next_step.

website.description: The site to scan, for example yourstore.com

email.description: Your user's work email. The report goes here

person_consented.description: True only if your user asked for the scan and agreed to get the report by email
